title: Nooch — Nutrition Planner Documentation
description: Documentation contract for Nooch’s nutrition-planner scenario: accepted native product representation, current finite delivery records and retained source history.

contract.extensionRule: Every durable scenario document should be registered here. Use docs/concepts/ for product and system concepts, docs/guides/ for task procedures, docs/reference/ for stable lookup material, docs/internal/ for developer and agent memory, docs/operations/ for runtime operations, docs/business/ for commercial strategy, and docs/domains/<domain>/ for domain-specific depth that would overload DOMAINS.md.
